name: Sydney Championship 2017
information:
**Date and time**
Saturday 16th of December from 9am until 6pm
Sunday 17th of December from 9am until 6pm

**Location**
Turramurra High School (MPC)
104 Maxwell Street
Turramurra NSW 2074

**Registration**
Entry is free for spectators.

There is a $20 registration fee for competitors. Please pay using the WCA Stripe system. Your registration will not be reviewed until payment is received. You will automatically go on a waiting list until your registration has been reviewed. All registrations are manually reviewed before approving (it may take a day or two before they're reviewed).
